facts.business: SPEL Semiconductor Limited is engaged in semiconductor manufacturing operations.

guidance_or_targets.statement: It is expected to improve production orders in FY 2026-27. The outlook for FY 2026-27 is good and SPEL has plans to introduce new Customers from Europe & US regions.

auditor.name: Venkatesh & Co., Chartered Accountants (FRN: 004636S)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (i) material uncertainty on going concern due to losses and negative cash flows; (ii) resignation of major employees causing operational uncertainty; (iii) major plant and machinery breakdown with no production in Q4 FY2025-26; (iv) trade receivables of Rs. 58.76 Lakhs and trade payables of Rs. 326.98 Lakhs subject to confirmation and reconciliation.

key_risks: Material uncertainty on going concern due to accumulated losses and negative cash flows
Significant reduction in employee strength due to resignation of major employees
Major plant and machinery breakdown leading to no production in Q4 FY2025-26
Trade receivables and payables subject to confirmation and reconciliation
